about_the_game:
Under a Desert Sun: Seekers of the Cursed Vessel

Venture beneath the burning sands. Face an ancient evil. Survive... or be consumed.

Under a Desert Sun: Seekers of the Cursed Vessel is a single-player and co-op action RPG set against the backdrop of World War II and the supernatural legends of ancient Egypt. Play solo or team up with friends in local co-op, with future plans for online multiplayer support. Battle through intense combat, deadly traps, and supernatural hordes as you unravel a dark tale of ancient curses, lost treasures, and personal redemption.

Heroes Rise. Darkness Falls.

Take up arms as one of two available heroes, with two more in active development during Early Access:

  • The Soldier – A gruff American WWII veteran, skilled in firearms and explosives. His loyalty to his fallen comrades drives him into a fight far beyond the battlefield he knows.

  • The Adventurer – A tough-as-nails treasure hunter with Nigerian roots. Sharp with a pistol and sharper with her wit, she’s in it for the gold—but destiny has other plans.

  • Two More Heroes Coming Soon – Stay tuned as Early Access evolves with new heroes, expanded skill trees, and stories that deepen the fight against the Heretic King.

Key Features:

  • Single Player & Co-op Action RPG
    Play solo or with friends via local co-op, with online multiplayer planned during Early Access.

  • Experience dynamic combat with action-driven gameplay and character-focused RPG elements.

  • Distinct Combat Styles

    • Master the Soldier’s long-range firepower, grenade use, and defensive shield tactics.

    • Utilize the Adventurer’s pistols, melee abilities, and her mystical ethereal bow.

    • Future heroes will offer pure melee, ranged-focused, and hybrid combat styles to suit different play preferences.

  • Atmospheric Exploration

    • Explore ancient tombs, vast deserts, and war-torn villages, all teeming with hidden dangers and environmental storytelling.

    • Navigate deadly traps, collapsed ruins, and supernatural anomalies lurking in the shadows.

  • Supernatural Meets Real-World Conflict

    • Battle both ruthless enemy soldiers and undead horrors unleashed by the stolen artifact.
      Witness the clash of historical warfare and mythological darkness in a unique setting.

  • A Rich, Cinematic Narrative

    • Experience a four-act campaign filled with personal character arcs, high-stakes missions, and the mystery surrounding the cursed vessel.

Early Access Roadmap:

  • Two heroes available at launch

  • One of the four acts playable

  • Local co-op for up to 4 players

  • New heroes, levels, and multiplayer features coming throughout Early Access

  • Community feedback will help shape ongoing development

The Artifact Is Stolen. The Pharaoh Awakens. The World Trembles.

Legends spoke of an artifact that binds the spirit of an ancient tyrant. Now, stolen by sinister forces, the Heretic King rises, bringing armies of the undead across the burning sands. With time running out, only you and your allies can stand against the darkness.

Will you survive the curse... or be lost beneath the desert sun?

Wishlist now and join the adventure as the sands of time run out!
